---
format: mail-gog
mail:
  # Sender: personal (user@example.com) or work (alias@example.com).
  sender: personal
  # Optional greeting before the message content. Delete it to omit the greeting.
  opening: Hi Jane,
  # Optional phrase before the sign-off name. Delete it to sign with the name
  # only.
  closing: Best,
  # Optional sign-off name: personal (Alex), formal (Alex Example), or work
  # (Alex Example). Delete the field to omit the name.
  identity: personal
  # Optional signature after the sign-off: uncomment work for the Example
  # Organization block.
  # signature: work
  # List all recipients, including for replies. Preserve known display names as
  # `First Last <email@example.com>`.
  to:
    - Jane Doe <jane@example.com>
  cc: []
  bcc: []
  # Required for a new message. Delete it from a reply to inherit the subject.
  subject: Example subject
  # Attachment paths are relative to this file.
  attachments: []
  # Reply: rendering fetches the original and preserves its Gmail thread.
  # Delete subject to inherit it. Set quote: true to include the original body.
  # reply-to-message-id: MESSAGE_ID
  # quote: true
  # Automatic reply-all replaces explicit To/Cc; omit it for chosen recipients.
  # reply-all: false
  # Forward instead of replying (mutually exclusive with reply-to-message-id).
  # Original attachments are included unless explicitly disabled.
  # forward-message-id: MESSAGE_ID
  # include-original-attachments: true
  # Delivery: send (default) or draft. Rendering never writes to Gmail.
  # delivery: draft
  # draft-id: EXISTING_DRAFT_ID
---

<!--
Write only the message content below. Do not add a greeting, closing, sender
name, or signature; Quarto Mail adds the configured opening and sign-off.
-->

Write the message body in Markdown.
